title: Cooling towers.
officialText:
Treated effluent shall only be utilized as water makeup on cooling towers equipped with drift
eliminators and shall be operated in accordance with the New York City Building Code and the New York City Mechanical Code.
SECTION PC C102
WASTEWATER RECYCLING SYSTEMS
